generate_text_udop: generate text from a document image using UdopForConditionalGeneration with OCR words and bounding boxes
encode_document_image: encode a document image with text tokens and bounding boxes using UdopEncoderModel to get hidden states
run_encoder_decoder_forward: run a full encoder-decoder forward pass with UdopModel using image pixel values and token input ids
combine_image_text_embeddings: combine image patch embeddings with text embeddings and bounding boxes for UDOP encoder input
compute_relative_position_bias: compute relative position bias from bounding box coordinates using RelativePositionBiasHorizontal and RelativePositionBiasVertical
